problem: Cross-project reuse notification mute was keyed by project-local database ID, so different project databases using ID 1 shared one Windows QSettings mute value.
cause: The notification key treated a locally unique project_id as globally unique across separate project databases; QSettings persisted outside isolated APPDATA in the Windows registry.
rule: Any per-project persistent setting shared across databases must use a stable globally unique project identity such as a normalized project-path digest, never a database-local numeric ID.
applies_to: UI notification preferences, QSettings keys, multi-project databases, isolated live tests
